sql: with pt as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, created_at, pnl/nullif(quantity,0)*100 as c from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 93 and 95 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' order by market_ticker, created_at), ph as (select pt.*, (select t.hours_to_close from mmsell_candidate_ticks t where t.market_ticker=pt.market_ticker and t.captured_at<=pt.created_at order by t.captured_at desc limit 1) as htc from pt), lo as (select market_ticker, min(created_at) as created_at, bool_or(status='filled') as filled from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and side='no' and action='buy' and limit_price between 93 and 95 and market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' group by 1), lh as (select lo.*, (select t.hours_to_close from mmsell_candidate_ticks t where t.market_ticker=lo.market_ticker and t.captured_at<=lo.created_at order by t.captured_at desc limit 1) as htc from lo), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl from positions where market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), b as (select 'paper' as src, case when htc is null then 'z?' when htc<4 then 'a <4h' when htc<12 then 'b 4-12h' when htc<24 then 'c 12-24h' else 'd 24h+' end as bucket, 1 as n, (c<0)::int as loser, c from ph union all select 'live', case when htc is null then 'z?' when htc<4 then 'a <4h' when htc<12 then 'b 4-12h' when htc<24 then 'c 12-24h' else 'd 24h+' end, 1, (filled and p.realized_pnl<0)::int, case when filled then 1 else 0 end from lh left join p using (market_ticker)) select src, bucket, sum(n) as mkts, sum(loser) as losers, round(avg(c)::numeric,2) as paper_c_or_fill_rate from b group by 1,2 order by 1,2
